card.name: Just before a word starting with br
card.fires_on: Responds at points where the next piece is likely to begin with "br", such as partway through an all-caps or coined word, or after botanical terms like bracts. Often it is an uppercase fragment (L, IN, FR) or a period after a plant description.

modes.label: Inside capitalized names
modes.description: Uppercase fragment of a brand or coined name where the next piece could start with br.
modes.example: KUKA Robotics created the<< L>>WR (lightweight robot)

modes.label: Mid-word in all-caps headings
modes.description: Part of an all-caps warning heading or word, such as VENTRICULAR, before the next word.

modes.label: Plant description ends
modes.description: A period after a botanical feature phrase, where another feature such as bracts may follow.
modes.example: Calyx teeth obsolete<<.>> Petals yellow, obovate

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next piece begins with "br" and lowers unrelated pieces.
card.plain: It fires where the text is likely to continue with a word starting with "br", across mixed settings.
